6277-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2741-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1339-1832-1939-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-1939-2034.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

728-3249-5173-6723.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5173-6723.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1659-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5686-7452.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

3240-5632-6462-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token, Clue token and creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3480-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a type chosen that matches a type of the persist creature

345-2292--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

206-632-2034-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
206-632-2034-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

4766-5256-7361.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more Spirits.
4766-5256-7361.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kodama.
When Kodama dies, its soulshift ability and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Kodama from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1824-2530-3497-7349.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3497-7349.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2530-3497-7349.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Diamond Mare triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

457-1329-2829-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.
457-1329-2829-7340.notes: You can untap an artifact creature with the second Sewer-veillance Cam trigger, and then tap it via Urza to get infinite blue mana. Once you have infinite blue mana, you can either use it for Urza's second ability and/or to activate Sewer-veillance Cam's ability to draw cards.

413-5571-7310--6.description:
Use Kitsune to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
When the undying creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

586-5258-5618-6797-7183.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2604-4331-4993-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: was foretold on a previous turn

3398-6999.notablePrerequisites:
You control another creature that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3398-6999.description:
Cast Sozin's Comet either from your hand by paying {3}{R}{R} or from exile for its foretell cost by paying {2}{R}, causing each creature you control to gain firebending 5 until end of turn.
Declare Hellkite Charger and at least one other creature as attackers, triggering each creature's firebending ability and Hellkite Charger.
Resolve each firebending trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R} for each attacking creature.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

141-3505-6797.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1115-1563-2457-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1115-1563-2457-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1090-3742.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1090-3742.notablePrerequisites: Restoration Angel exiled by Phantom Steed
372-1090-3742.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Phantom Steed and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Restoration Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Phantom Steed to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Phantom Steed and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Phantom Steed and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

465-969-3742-4251-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-969-3742-4251-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

527-4790-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
527-4790-5295.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Selvala that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
If you control two Selvala tokens, put the oldest token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate the Selvala token by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 8 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana.

1636-3484-4023-4659-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Dr Madison Li does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least five energy counters.
1636-3484-4023-4659-4840.description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it, Intruder Alarm and Decoction Module triggers.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Decoction Module trigger four times.
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve all Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

859-4702-5070.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Lurking Roper.
859-4702-5070.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the Lurking Roper token's toughness.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.

1591-2634-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
1591-2634-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

751-3179-4050.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2190-2390-4625-5299.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to place a counter on a permanent or player.
2190-2390-4625-5299.description:
Place a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Vraska triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on All Will Be One.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4200-4577.notablePrerequisites: At least four reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
4050-4200-4577.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart, adding {1}.
Magnanimous Magistrate triggers, allowing you to remove four reprieve counters from it and return Icewind Stalwart from the graveyard to the battlefield.
Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, blinking Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.

1961-2369-2793-5089.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Throne of Geth ability, putting a loyalty counter on Karn.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing a noncreature artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1365-2034-2589-4404.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Ridgescale Tusker and Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Corridor Monitor, adding {C}{C}.
Corridor Monitor dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ridgescale Tusker, adding {C}{C}.
Ridgescale Tusker dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Ridgescale Tusker enters the battlefield, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

1297-1558.notablePrerequisites:
Inquisitor Eisenhorn has at least 5 power each turn.
Inquisitor Eisenhorn cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Inquisitor Eisenhorn does not have summoning sickness.
1297-1558.description:
Declare Inquisitor Eisenhorn as an attacker.
Inquisitor Eisenhorn deals combat damage, triggering itself, investigating at least five times.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Clue tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

3186-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
You control a Samurai or a Warrior that can attack each turn.
An opponent can not block and kill the Samurai or Warrior.
3186-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase.
Declare any Warrior or Samurai you control as an attacker with no other attackers.
Heiko triggers, allowing you to cast Coretapper from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Coretapper from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

575-3693-4489.description:
Cast Walking Ballista for {X} = 0.
Walking Ballista dies to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Tap that Forest for {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Walking Ballista, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {G}, you may cast Walking Ballista using an arbitrarily large amount of mana, and then use its second ability to deal an arbitrarily large amount of damage to any target(s).

1174-2104-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
1174-2104-4423.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Temporal Manipulation on top of your library.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand, untapping any land.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
